text.EQUIPA <whitebold>Anochecer</>. DISPARA: EQUIP Nightfall. FIRE to send out a wave that deafens, applies decay and marks enemies.
text.EQUIPA <whitebold>Armonía</>. DISPARA ap: EQUIP Harmonize. FIRE aiming at an ally to grant both of you a combat boost and speed. The boost resets when you get kills while it is active and if both Harmonized players are still alive. Use ALTERNATE FIRE to apply it to yourself with no chance of resetting it.
EQUIP Dimensional Drift. FIRE to become intangible and invisible. Gatecrash is available during this state. REACTIVATE to exit early.
text.EQUIPA <whitebold>Capturar</>. DISPARA p: EQUIP Seize. FIRE to throw. REACTIVATE to release early. On landing, it deafens, applies decay and immobilizes enemies.
text.EQUIPA <whitebold>Carambola</>. DISPARA: EQUIP Meddle. FIRE to throw. It explodes on landing and applies decay to all players.

text.EQUIPA <whitebold>Cinestesia</>. DISPARA: EQUIP Kinesthesia. FIRE to throw it. Or use ALT FIRE to prepare it and RE-ACTIVATE to throw it where your crosshair is aiming. text.EQUIPA <whitebold>Contingencia</>. DISPA: EQUIP Contingency. FIRE to send an indestructible wall that blocks vision forward. Use ALTERNATE FIRE to send a slower wall.
text.EQUIPA <whitebold>Cortacaminos</>. DISPA: EQUIP Shear. FIRE to place it. Shear goes stealth after being placed. It triggers when enemies walk over it and, after a short delay, creates an indestructible wall for a moment. Can be recovered during the BUY PHASE.
text.EQUIPA <whitebold>Cortina Tóxica</>. DIS: EQUIP Toxic Screen. FIRE to send it forward and place a line of emitters. Press the ability key again to use fuel and create a toxic wall that blocks vision and applies decay to enemies.

INTERACT to turn the marker into a clone. Clones keep moving forward and turn toward the first enemy that shoots them. This applies blindness to all players looking at them.
text.EQUIPA <whitebold>Entrega Especial</>. D: EQUIP Special Delivery. FIRE to throw it. Use ALTERNATE FIRE to throw it with a bounce. It explodes on contact with any surface, concussing and dealing damage to all players.
text.EQUIPA <whitebold>FRAG/mentación</>. DIS: EQUIP FRAG/ment. FIRE to throw. Use ALTERNATE FIRE to throw it underhand. It explodes on landing and deals continuous pulses of damage to all players.
text.EQUIPA <whitebold>Falla Sísmica</>. MANT: EQUIP Fault Line. HOLD FIRE to increase the distance. RELEASE to detonate a zone that concusses all players.
text.EQUIPA <whitebold>Fosa Vipérea</>. DISPA: EQUIP Viper's Pit. FIRE to form a large toxic cloud that blocks vision and applies Decay to enemies inside it. HOLD ACTIVATE to cancel the cloud.
EQUIP Hunter's Fury. FIRE to launch a zone that deals damage. Can be fired up to two more times. Enemies hit are left visible to Sova.
text.EQUIPA <whitebold>GravNet</>. DISPARA pa: EQUIP GravNet. FIRE to throw. Use ALTERNATE FIRE to throw it underhand. It explodes on landing and forces all players to crouch and move slowly until they get out of the net.
text.EQUIPA <whitebold>Ilusión Convergente</>: EQUIP Convergent Paths. FIRE to gain speed and launch a zone that hinders all players.
text.EQUIPA <whitebold>Infiltración</>. DISPA: EQUIP Gatecrash. FIRE to send it forward. Use ALTERNATE FIRE to place it. RE-ACTIVATE to teleport to it. INTERACT to fake a teleport. Resets every two kills.

text.EQUIPA <whitebold>La Incendiaria</>. DIS: EQUIP Incendiary. FIRE to throw it. On landing, it creates a zone that deals damage to all players.
text.EQUIPA <whitebold>La Mirada</> destructi: EQUIP a destructible Leer. FIRE to send it out. After a short delay, it forms and nearsights enemies who look at it.
text.EQUIPA <whitebold>Lista Negra</>. DISPAR: EQUIP Kill Contract. FIRE to throw a zone that pulls you and the first enemy hit into a duel. Channel Focus at the start of a duel.
text.EQUIPA <whitebold>Malla Protectora</>. D: EQUIP Barrier Mesh. FIRE to throw. On landing, it creates destructible nodes that fortify after a short delay. These nodes form barriers that block player movement.
EQUIP Hot Hands. FIRE to throw. Use ALTERNATE FIRE to throw it underhand. On landing, it creates a zone of fire that deals damage to all players.
text.EQUIPA <whitebold>Mordedura</>. DISPARA: EQUIP Snake Bite. FIRE to throw it. On landing, it creates a zone that applies vulnerable and deals light damage to all players.
text.EQUIPA <whitebold>Muro Abrasador</>. DIS: EQUIP Blaze. FIRE to throw a wall of fire that blocks vision and deals damage to all players. HOLD FIRE to steer it in the direction of your crosshair.

text.EQUIPA <whitebold>Punto Ciego</>. DISPAR: EQUIP Blindside. FIRE to throw. When it bounces off a surface, it explodes and blinds every player looking at the explosion.
text.EQUIPA <whitebold>Regeneración</>. MANTÉ: EQUIP Regrowth. HOLD FIRE to heal allies within range and line of sight. Uses limited healing energy. Cannot heal herself.
text.EQUIPA <whitebold>Resurrección</>. DISPA: EQUIP Resurrection. FIRE at a selected dead ally to resurrect them.
text.EQUIPA <whitebold>Réplica</>. DISPARA pa: EQUIP Aftershock. FIRE to launch an exploding zone through a wall, dealing damage to anyone it hits.
text.EQUIPA <whitebold>Saturación</>. DISPARA: EQUIP Saturate. FIRE to throw it. It explodes on landing and applies hindrance to all players.
